SPECIAL POLICE
REGISTRY.
THE CHINA PRESS: THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 1934 D

Engineer Fined
For Use Of A
False Passport

Judge Imposes Fine Of
$400 For Offense And
For Possessing Firearm

Mircea Lupescu, 34-year-old Rou-
manian engineer, was fined $400
with the alternative of serving 200
days' imprisonment by Judge Dzian
in the First Special District Court
yesterday morning for using a false
passport and for possession of
firearms without a permit.

Lupescu was arrested on October
28 and was found in possession of
a Canadian passport in the name
of G. P. Dorandi, under which
name he had been going in Shang-
hai. In the pocket of his coat the
police found a "Bauer" 6.35 caliber
automatic pistol and 6 rounds of
ammunition.

On October 28 Lupescu was
brought up in court on a writ of
detention and on November 7 he
was formally charged with being in
possession of a forged passport and
with possession of an automatic
pistol and ammunition without au-
thority. Dr. F. Wilhelm, appearing
on behalf of Lupescu, contended at
the hearing that under the Chinese
Criminal Code a man could not be
charged for being in possession of a
forged passport allegedly issued by
a foreign power.

Judge Dzian, however, overruled
the contention of the defense at-
torney and fined Lupescu $200 for
using a false passport. He then fined
him $200 for possession of firearms
without authority and combined
the two fines to $400 in all.

Dr. Wilhelm's contention regard-
ing the charge of possession of fire-
arms was that Lupescu did not
keep the pistol on his person, but
in the pocket of his coat, and under
the French Concession regulations,
where he was arrested, a person
does not require a permit to keep
a pistol; this was also overruled.

《字林西报》：1934年11月8日，星期四 D

工程师因使用
假护照被罚款

法官判处罚款
400美元以惩罪行
及非法持有枪支

34岁的罗马尼亚工程师米尔恰·卢佩斯库（Mircea Lupescu），昨天上午在第一特区法院被齐安（Dzian）法官判处400美元罚款，或 alternatively 服200天监禁，罪名是使用假护照以及无证持有枪支。

卢佩斯库于10月28日被捕，警方发现他持有一本名为G. P. 多兰迪（G. P. Dorandi）的加拿大护照，他在上海一直使用该名字。在他的外套口袋里，警方发现了一把“鲍尔”（Bauer）牌6.35口径自动手枪和6发子弹。

10月28日，卢佩斯库依据拘留令出庭，11月7日，他被正式指控持有伪造护照以及未经授权持有自动手枪和弹药。代表卢佩斯库出庭的F. 威廉博士（Dr. F. Wilhelm）在听证会上辩称，根据《中华民国刑法》，一个人不能因持有据称由外国政府签发的伪造护照而被起诉。

然而，齐安法官驳回了辩护律师的主张，就使用假护照一项对卢佩斯库罚款200美元。随后，他就未经授权持有枪支一项对其罚款200美元，并将两项罚款合并，共计400美元。

关于持有枪支的指控，威廉博士辩称，卢佩斯库并未将手枪随身携带，而是放在外套口袋里；且在其被捕的法租界规章下，个人存放手枪无需许可证。这一主张也被驳回。

Date 5 / 1 / 34

THE CHINA PRESS, SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 3, 1934

Rumanian Engineer Charged
With Using Forged Passport

Formal charges of using a forged passport as genuine and possession of arms and ammunition were framed against Mircea Lupescu, 34-year-old Rumanian engineer, in the First Special District Court yesterday morning. Lupescu had been passing in Shanghai under the name of G. P. Dorandi, being in possession of a Canadian passport in that name.

After a short hearing during which Dr. F. Wilhelm, appearing on behalf of Lupescu, contended that under the Chinese Criminal Code a man could not be charged for being in possession of a forged passport allegedly issued by a foreign power, Judge Dzlen allowed Lupescu to be released on $3,000 cash or shop security until the next hearing, which he set for Wednesday, November 7.

With regard to the charge that Lupescu kept a "Sauer" 6.34 caliber automatic pistol and 6 rounds of ammunition without authority, Dr. Wilhelm contended that Lupescu did not keep the pistol on his person, but in the pocket of his car, and under the French Concession regulations, where he was arrested, a person does not require a permit to keep a pistol. Dr. Wilhelm contended that no proof was produced by the prosecution that Lupescu ever appeared in the Settlement with the pistol.

The prosecution objected to Lupescu's release on bail during the period of remand, but was overruled by the judge.

Questioned again as to why he used the forged passport and was going under an assumed name, Lupescu again stated that he had previously had an affair with a lady and therefore had changed his name.

《字林西报》，1934年11月3日，星期六

罗马尼亚工程师被控
使用伪造护照

昨天上午，在第一特区法院，对34岁的罗马尼亚工程师米尔恰·卢佩斯库（Mircea Lupescu）提出了正式指控，罪名为将伪造护照当作真实护照使用，以及持有武器和弹药。卢佩斯库在上海一直以G. P. 多兰迪（G. P. Dorandi）的名字活动，并持有以此名字命名的加拿大护照。

在简短的听证会上，代表卢佩斯库出庭的F. 威廉博士辩称，根据《中华民国刑法》，一个人不能因持有据称由外国政府签发的伪造护照而被起诉。随后，齐伦（Dzlen）法官允许卢佩斯库以3,000美元现金或商铺担保释放，直至下次开庭，他将下次开庭日期定为11月7日，星期三。

关于卢佩斯库未经授权持有一把“绍尔”（Sauer）牌6.34口径自动手枪和6发子弹的指控，威廉博士辩称，卢佩斯库并未将手枪随身携带，而是放在汽车口袋里，且在其被捕的法租界规章下，个人存放手枪无需许可证。威廉博士还辩称，检方未能提供证据证明卢佩斯库曾携带该手枪出现在租界内。

检方反对在还押候审期间对卢佩斯库进行保释，但被法官驳回。

当再次被问及为何使用伪造护照并以化名活动时，卢佩斯库再次陈述称，他此前曾与一位女士有染，因此更改了姓名。

JW

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, SATURDAY, OCTOBER 27, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 2860 Date 30 / 10 / 34）

SECOND PASSPORT
MYSTERY CASE
Court Grants Police
Request To Detain
Rumanian

The second case concerning passports to be brought before the First District Court within a week was heard yesterday when a Police request for the remand of Mucca Lupescu, Rumanian, aged 44, was granted.
For the Police, it was stated that although no specific charge had been made against Lupescu, they wished to detain him in connection with a case of passport forgery. When arrested by the Police, it was added, the accused man was carrying a pistol.
Lupescu was remanded in custody until Friday.
The previous case concerning a passport to appear before the court was on Monday, when Anton Wirthmuller, a German, was asked to answer a number of questions concerning a passport found in his possession.
It was stated by the authorities on that occasion that a forged passport bearing Wirthmuller's photograph was found in his trunk. Wirthmuller, in reply, explained that he was a German Royalist, and that when he left Germany to visit friends in Paris, political friends gave him the passport in case he might require it on return to Germany.
He had entered China with his own official passport as the agent of a German motor factory, and had registered at the German Consulate-General.
He had not destroyed the other passport, he said, because he wished to send it back to his friends.
Wirthmuller was asked to furnish $300 security, and the case was adjourned for a week.

《上海泰晤士报》，1934年10月27日，星期六
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 S. B. 登记处。编号 D 2860 日期 34年10月30日）

第二起护照
谜案
法院批准警方
拘留罗马尼亚人
的请求

一周内提交第一区法院审理的第二起护照案件于昨日开庭，警方请求还押罗马尼亚人穆卡·卢佩斯库（Mucca Lupescu），44岁，获准。
警方陈述称，虽然尚未对卢佩斯库提出具体指控，但他们希望因一起护照伪造案将其拘留。此外，警方补充说，该被告被捕时携带一把手枪。
卢佩斯库被还押候审，直至周五。
此前提交法院审理的护照案件发生在周一，当时德国人安东·维尔特米勒（Anton Wirthmuller）被要求回答有关在其身上发现的一本护照的若干问题。
当局在那次场合陈述称，在其行李箱中发现了一本印有维尔特米勒照片的伪造护照。维尔特米勒回答说，他是一名德国保皇派，当他离开德国去巴黎拜访朋友时，政治上的朋友给了他这本护照，以备他返回德国时可能需要。
他是作为德国一家汽车工厂的代理人，持自己的官方护照进入中国的，并在德国总领事馆进行了注册。
他说，他没有销毁另一本护照，是因为他想把它寄回给朋友们。
维尔特米勒被要求提供300美元担保，案件延期一周审理。

（批注：$2，请知悉并转交西区登记处。怀特。MG）

AMERICAN EXPRESS COMPANY
65 Broadway New York, N. Y.

WARNING

The persons described herein are INTERNATIONAL FORGERS specilizing and manipu-
lating LETTERS OF CREDIT. Any one of them may call at your office to purchase a Letter
of Credit or negotiate a draft upon one which has been forged. They operate in all parts of
the world.
All are believed to be at large and to be active. If any one of these persons comes to
your office exercise the greatest care in all transactions. Keep party under surveillance. If
a Letter of Credit or Travelers Cheques, reported on bulletin as lost or stolen, are presented
for encashment, notify police immediately and telegraph Inspector Richer, 65 Broadway,
New York, N. Y., full informtaion of the transaction.

1. VASILE DIMITRI MURGULESCU

Alias
Vital Vasili, Count Vittorio Morisini, Francois de Valabrega, Henry
Douglas Waltuck, Count Vittorio, Prince de Trevise, Solomon Hecht,
Morris Dolber, Jean Basile, Jean Jargulescu, Nino Valabrega, Francois De
Marville, S. Mayer, Max Bruter, Frederick J. Griffiths, George Hausman,
Isidor Zarazinski, Ibrahim Bey Fayasof and Harry Linder.

DESCRIPTION AND DETAILS
Age 34 1930 Eyes Brown, slant
Height 5 feet 6½ inches Mongolian manner
Weight 155 lbs. Complexion Dark
Hair Dark brown Generally clean shaven. Sometimes
wears mustache.
Believed to be member of same gang as Lupescu (2) and Brown (3)

HAS SCAR ON UPPER RIGHT CORNER OF MOUTH. His appearance is Slavonic and his eyes resemble the Mongolian
slanting type. Speaks a number of foreign languages fluently, and English with a foreign accent. Very refined in manner of
speech and actions, and very particular as to personal appearance. Wears a soft hat very low on the head, almost down on his ears.

He is known within the last year to have operated in Egypt, Spain, Germany, New York and California.
He is believed to be in possession of American Express Travelers Cheques and Travelers Cheque Exchange Orders issued to
Isidor Zarazinski, Solomon Hecht and George Hausman. Also believed to be in possession of Letters of Credit in the names of
Harry Linden and Morris Dolber.
He is believed to be connected with a well known gang of Roumanian and Italian forgers and to be skillful in imitating
handwriting, erasing entries on Letters of Credit and raising and altering the numbers and amounts of Letters of Credit.
If you identify this man have him taken into custody, inform the police and the American Express Company will prosecute.
WIRE immediately to D. E. Richer, Inspector, 65 Broadway, New York, N. Y.

警告

本文所述人员系国际伪造犯，专门从事信用证的伪造和操纵。他们中任何一人都可能前往贵办公室购买信用证，或就伪造的信用证进行汇票谈判。他们在世界各地活动。
据信所有人均在逃且活动频繁。如果其中任何人来到贵办公室，请在所有交易中格外小心。对该人保持监视。如果出示据通报遗失或被盗的信用证或旅行支票要求兑现，请立即通知警方，并向纽约州纽约市百老汇65号的里彻（Richer）督察发电报，提供交易的完整信息。

1. 瓦西里·迪米特里·穆尔古列斯库

别名
维塔尔·瓦西里（Vital Vasili）、维托里奥·莫里西尼伯爵（Count Vittorio Morisini）、弗朗索瓦·德·瓦拉布雷加（Francois de Valabrega）、亨利·道格拉斯·沃尔塔克（Henry Douglas Waltuck）、维托里奥伯爵（Count Vittorio）、特雷维斯亲王（Prince de Trevise）、所罗门·赫克特（Solomon Hecht）、莫里斯·多尔伯（Morris Dolber）、让·巴西勒（Jean Basile）、让·贾尔古列斯库（Jean Jargulescu）、尼诺·瓦拉布雷加（Nino Valabrega）、弗朗索瓦·德·马尔维尔（Francois De Marville）、S. 迈耶（S. Mayer）、马克斯·布鲁特（Max Bruter）、弗雷德里克·J. 格里菲斯（Frederick J. Griffiths）、乔治·豪斯曼（George Hausman）、伊西多尔·扎拉津斯基（Isidor Zarazinski）、易卜拉欣·贝伊·法亚索夫（Ibrahim Bey Fayasof）和哈里·林德（Harry Linder）。

外貌特征及详情
年龄 34岁（1930年） 眼睛 棕色，斜视
身高 5英尺6½英寸 蒙古人种特征
体重 155磅 肤色 黝黑
头发 深棕色 通常面部光洁。有时
留胡须。
据信与卢佩斯库（2）和布朗（3）属于同一团伙

嘴角右上方有疤痕。其相貌具有斯拉夫特征，眼睛类似蒙古人的斜眼类型。能流利地说多种外语，英语带有外国口音。言谈举止非常文雅，对个人外表非常讲究。头戴软帽，压得很低，几乎盖住耳朵。

已知他在过去一年中在埃及、西班牙、德国、纽约和加利福尼亚活动。
据信他持有开具给伊西多尔·扎拉津斯基、所罗门·赫克特和乔治·豪斯曼的美国运通旅行支票及旅行支票兑换单。还据信他持有以哈里·林登（Harry Linden）和莫里斯·多尔伯名义开具的信用证。
据信他与一个著名的罗马尼亚和意大利伪造团伙有关联，擅长模仿笔迹，擦除信用证上的条目，以及涂改和变更信用证的号码和金额。
如识别出此人，请将其拘留，通知警方，美国运通公司将提起诉讼。
立即致电纽约州纽约市百老汇65号的D. E. 里彻（D. E. Richer）督察。
